RACHANA

Senior Business Analyst | Scrum Master | US Healthcare

Bangalore, Karnataka, India | 9686056131 | rachanasuvarna91@gmail.com

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Senior Business Analyst and Scrum Master with 9.5 years of experience delivering solutions across US Healthcare, Life Sciences and Pharmaceutical environments. Hands-on experience working with both payer and provider business processes, translating business needs into clear functional requirements and driving delivery with cross-functional Agile teams. Strong in requirement elicitation, BRD/FRD/URS, user stories, acceptance criteria, process modelling, UAT, SQL validation and stakeholder management. Healthcare experience includes EHR workflows, HL7, FHIR, HIPAA and X12 EDI transactions including 834, 835 and 837. Experienced in regulated environments involving GxP, 21 CFR Part 11 and IQ/OQ/PQ validation activities. Comfortable owning backlogs, facilitating Scrum ceremonies, managing risks and supporting releases from requirement definition through production.

CORE COMPETENCIES

Business Analysis: Requirement Elicitation, Stakeholder Workshops, BRD, FRD, URS, GAP Analysis, Use Cases, User Stories,

Acceptance Criteria, RTM, Process Flows, Wireframes, UAT.

Agile / Scrum: Scrum Master, Sprint Planning, Backlog Grooming, Backlog Prioritization, Refinement, Sprint Reviews, Retrospectives,

Story Point Estimation, Release Planning and Delivery Tracking.

US Healthcare – Payer & Provider: Payer and provider workflows, enrollment, eligibility, benefits, claims, reimbursement, provider

information, EHR workflows and healthcare data exchange.

EDI & Interoperability: X12 EDI, 834 Enrollment, 835 Remittance, 837 Claims, HL7, FHIR, healthcare interfaces, data mapping and

validation.

Regulatory / Validation: HIPAA, GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, IQ, OQ, PQ, validation documentation, requirements traceability and

compliance-focused delivery.

Tools: JIRA, Azure DevOps, Trello, SQL, Bizagi, BPMN, MS Visio, Balsamiq, Lucidchart, UML, SDLC documentation.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Senior Business Analyst / Scrum Master | Tieto HealthCare — Bangalore, India | July 2024 – Present

Work with US healthcare and life sciences stakeholders across payer and provider environments to understand business needs,

define scope and own requirement delivery.

Lead requirement workshops, interviews, process discussions and interface analysis; document BRDs, FRDs, URS, use cases, user

stories and acceptance criteria.

Analyze payer and provider workflows covering enrollment, eligibility, benefits, claims, provider information and reimbursement-

related processes.

Work hands-on with healthcare data exchange requirements involving X12 EDI transactions such as 834 Enrollment, 835 Remittance

and 837 Claims, including business rules, data requirements, validation scenarios and exception handling.

Work with EHR and interoperability requirements involving HL7 and FHIR, coordinating with technical teams on interface

requirements, data validation and UAT.

Facilitate Sprint Planning, Backlog Grooming, Sprint Reviews, Retrospectives and requirement refinement; help teams stay focused

on sprint commitments and delivery priorities.

Manage product and sprint backlogs in JIRA and Azure DevOps, refine PBIs, prioritize requirements and maintain acceptance criteria

with Product Owners and business stakeholders.

Work closely with developers, QA, UX, architects and business teams to clarify requirements, resolve blockers, assess feasibility and

support sprint execution.

Use SQL for backend/data validation, requirement verification, defect analysis and UAT support; work with QA to review test

scenarios and resolve requirement-related issues.

Perform As-Is/To-Be analysis, GAP analysis, workflow modelling and feasibility assessment using BPMN, Bizagi, Visio and UML. • Support risk analysis, RFC/CAB activities, change requests and release coordination while maintaining requirement traceability. • Work within regulated healthcare and life sciences environments involving HIPAA and GxP requirements, including 21 CFR Part 11 and IQ/OQ/PQ validation activities and supporting documentation.

Senior Business Analyst / Scrum Master | Ignite IPA Pvt Ltd — Pune, India | Nov 2021 – July 2024

Worked with healthcare and life sciences clients across payer and provider-related processes, gathering requirements and translating

business needs into functional solutions.

Led stakeholder discussions and prepared user stories, use cases, acceptance criteria, process models, mockups and functional

documentation for product features.

Partnered with engineering teams during backlog grooming, sprint planning and requirement refinement and supported releases,

bug fixes and change requests.

Applied Planning Poker/story-point estimation and worked with teams to identify functional and non-functional requirements. • Facilitated sprint reviews and retrospectives and worked with customers, Product Owners, UX, architects, developers and testers to remove roadblocks and improve delivery quality.

Supported UAT, defect analysis and change-management activities and ensured requirements were understood and validated

through development and testing.

Senior Business Analyst / Business Analyst | Tieto Evry Pvt Ltd — Bangalore, India | Nov 2017 – Oct 2021

Handled requirement gathering and analysis across application enhancements, working with customers and business users to

understand needs and clarify scope.

Supported healthcare business processes across payer and provider stakeholders and translated business requirements into clear

functional documentation.

Prepared and reviewed URDs and BRDs, created RFCs and coordinated change requests through implementation and release. • Led backlog grooming, sprint planning and requirement refinement sessions and supported delivery of MVPs and PBIs under aggressive timelines.

Acted as the bridge between customers, Product Owners, UX designers, architects, developers and testers to resolve roadblocks and

maintain requirement clarity.

Created use cases, process models, mockups and workflow diagrams using Bizagi, Balsamiq and MS Visio and supported product

demonstrations.

Worked with QA teams to review requirements and acceptance criteria, support defect clarification and ensure expected

functionality was delivered.

End-to-end requirement lifecycle ownership from discovery and stakeholder workshops through development, testing, UAT and

release.

Backlog ownership and prioritization based on business value, dependencies, delivery timelines and stakeholder priorities. • Facilitation of Agile ceremonies and coordination between Product Owners, business stakeholders, developers, QA, UX and architecture teams.

Preparation of functional and non-functional requirements, process flows, data requirements, acceptance criteria and supporting

documentation.

Root-cause analysis and issue clarification using SQL/data validation and collaboration with technical teams. • Change management, RFC/CAB coordination, risk tracking, release support and retrospective-driven process improvements.

US HEALTHCARE DOMAIN EXPERTISE

Payer & Provider Operations: Hands-on exposure to payer and provider workflows, healthcare operations, member/provider

information, eligibility, enrollment, benefits, claims and reimbursement processes.

Claims & EDI: Hands-on experience with X12 EDI requirements covering 834 Enrollment, 835 Remittance and 837 Claims, including

business rules, data elements, validation and exception scenarios.

Healthcare Interoperability: HL7 and FHIR-based healthcare interfaces, EHR workflows, data exchange requirements and

backend/data validation.

Compliance & Quality: HIPAA, GxP and regulated healthcare/life sciences delivery; 21 CFR Part 11 awareness and hands-on

participation in IQ/OQ/PQ validation documentation and activities.

Testing & UAT: Requirement validation, test-case review, defect triage, UAT coordination, traceability and production issue support.

TOOLS & TECHNOLOGIES

Agile / Delivery: JIRA, Azure DevOps, Trello, Scrum, Agile, SDLC, backlog and release management. • Business Analysis: BRD, FRD, URS, GAP Analysis, Use Cases, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, UML, BPMN, process modelling, wireframes and workflow documentation.

• Healthcare: EHR, HL7, FHIR, HIPAA, X12 EDI, 834, 835, 837, GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, IQ/OQ/PQ. • Technical: SQL queries, data analysis and backend validation; Bizagi, Balsamiq, MS Visio and Lucidchart.

EDUCATION

Master of Computer Application (MCA) — NMAMIT / Nitte University | 2016

AWARDS & RECOGNITION

Outstanding Performance Award — Recognized for driving top 5% revenue performance in Q3 2023. • Star Performer — Q4 2020.

LANGUAGES

English — Native / Full Professional
